annotations.title: Shops, health, transport and parks nearby

description: Everyday places near an address from OpenStreetMap, in five groups: groceries (supermarket, corner shop), health (doctor or GP, pharmacy, dentist, hospital), getting around (train, metro, tram, bus, EV charging), kids and family (playground, park, childcare, library, sports centre) and out and about (cafe, pub, restaurant, gym, dog park, golf, post office). For each: the nearest with miles, walk minutes and (for the key ones) drive minutes, and how many are within a 15 minute walk. Includes a 15 minute walk check out of 7 everyday needs. US and UK.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).
